The engineer provides On-Call support, works proactively to improve service reliability and collaborates with internal teams and vendors to deliver stable, secure and efficient hybrid IT services. Optimize Azure resource consumption using Azure Cost Management, Reserved Instances, and right-sizing recommendations. Implement Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, and Azure Sentinel / Defender for Cloud for unified observability and security posture management. Server & On Prem Infrastructure Operations Administer and support VMware and Hyper V environments Implement and maintain Azure Arc to extend Azure management and governance to on-premises and multi-cloud resources Manage configuration management, patching, lifecycle updates and capacity planning Maintain on premises Active Directory including Group Policies for secure configuration and access control Oversee server monitoring, performance analysis, backups, recovery testing and system health Deploy, configure, and lifecycle-manage Dell EMC VxRail hyper-converged infrastructure clusters including node expansion and firmware updates. Administer VMware vSphere / vCenter integrated within the VxRail environment including ESXi host management, vMotion, DRS, HA, and vSAN configuration. Architect, deploy, and manage Windows Server Hyper-V standalone hosts and Failover Clustering environments (WSFC). Configure and maintain Hyper-V Replica for VM-level replication between sites as part of DR strategy. Perform VM migrations between Hyper-V hosts (Live Migration, Quick Migration) and between platforms (VxRail ↔ Hyper-V) using tools such as MVMC or third-party converters. Implement unified monitoring, alerting, and ITSM integration across Azure and on-premises using System Center and Azure native tooling. Drive infrastructure automation using PowerShell, Azure CLI, and CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps / GitHub Actions) to reduce manual effort. Lead capacity planning, performance baseline, and trend analysis for both cloud and on-premises workloads. Participate in incident management, problem management, and root-cause analysis (RCA) for P1/P2 infrastructure issues. Endpoint & Device Management Manage Intune endpoint policies, compliance, software deployment and device configuration Support remote and hybrid workforce using remote support tools Enforce endpoint security baselines across Windows 11, Windows 365 and mobile devices Operational Support & Incident Resolution Resolve incidents, problems and service requests in ITSM Troubleshoot complex issues across cloud, server, identity, endpoint and hybrid environments Participate in on call rotations for rapid incident response and continuity Mitigate operational problems proactively and perform root cause analysis Configuration, Automation & Continuous Improvement Maintain configuration documentation and operational runbooks Support automation using scripting, GitHub workflows and AI or agent‑driven automation tools Use AI‑based insights for troubleshooting, monitoring and system optimization Operate System Center Operations Manager (SCOM) for infrastructure and application monitoring manages management packs, alerts, dashboards, and maintenance windows. Identify opportunities to reduce manual effort and increase reliability through proactive improvements Collaboration & Stakeholder Engagement Collaborate with internal teams (Cloud, Security, Delivery, Service Desk) and external vendors Communicate system changes, incidents and operational updates clearly Provide effective operational support to internal business users What we ask for: Experience with Intune endpoint management for policies, compliance, software deployment and device configuration Experience with Azure cloud operations, virtual machines, storage and monitoring Proven hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure IaaS/PaaS services, Azure networking, and hybrid connectivity patterns Administration of on‑premises Active Directory including Group Policies Hands‑on experience with VMware and Hyper‑V Strong proficiency with Microsoft Hyper-V, Failover Clustering, and Windows Server (2019/2022/2025) Experience operating Windows 365 cloud PCs Experience with configuration management, patching, lifecycle updates and baseline compliance Good understanding of Entra ID identity and access management Familiarity with remote support tools for hybrid workforce support Experience with Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, PKI, and hybrid identity (Azure AD Connect / Entra Connect) Knowledge of server and endpoint monitoring, logs, alerting and backup systems Familiarity with backup, DR, and BCP strategies across hybrid environments. Experience using AI‑assisted operational tools for troubleshooting, automation and proactive recommendations Ability to troubleshoot complex issues across cloud and on Prem environments Experience with Jira Service Management for incident, problem and request handling Understanding of hybrid infrastructure and cloud migration operations Experience with scripting or automation (GitHub, PowerShell, Python is a plus) Ability to work in On-Call rotations and maintain high operational reliability Certifications Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate (AZ‑104) preferred Microsoft 365 Administrator Associate or equivalent is useful ITIL 4 Foundation for ITSM processes Certifications in automation or AI‑assisted operations are a plus (Microsoft Applied Skills for automation or GitHub Foundations) We are keen to hear from you even if you don’t match all listed requirements, but you identify with our brand and passion for innovation. What we offer: Our heritage We aspire to be an indispensable company, trusted throughout the world for our commitment to openness, customer satisfaction and sustainability. We respect individuality while promoting teamwork, and we are committed to delivering unique value through innovative and creative solutions. Our commitment to the environment We all have a role to play in building a better future. For Epson, being a sustainable company means being mindful of every aspect of our organisation – from the smallest lightbulb to the largest factory. It fuels our innovation, drives our growth, motivates our workforce and, ultimately, to contribute to society. Our people We believe a healthy culture, strong values, teamwork, and contribution from a diverse range of individuals will help us to strive for excellence. Our brand Ranked by Clarivate Analytics as a Top 100 Global Innovator brand for the last seven years running. Epson is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are dedicated to fostering an inclusive environment for all employees. We actively encourage applications from individuals of all protected characteristics and are committed to providing any necessary accommodations during the application and assessment process, as well as upon joining our team. If you require additional assistance for your application or wheelchair access to our facilities, please email recruitment@epson.eu. A member of our team will be happy to assist you.

El rol tendrá responsabilidad sobre el equipo de Sistemas (dos administradores de sistemas y dos técnicos de soporte/HelpDesk), la operación de la infraestructura corporativa, los servicios IT y la gestión del SGSI. Asimismo, será necesaria una coordinación estrecha con las áreas de desarrollo de software, plataformas de negocio, data e IA en materia de seguridad, identidades, infraestructura compartida y cumplimiento. Responsabilidades. ¿Qué harás en tu día a día? 1) Liderazgo del equipo de Sistemas Liderar, coordinar y desarrollar el equipo de Sistemas. Organizar la actividad diaria del equipo, priorizando incidencias, peticiones, cambios, proyectos y tareas recurrentes. Establecer objetivos, criterios de calidad y mecanismos de seguimiento operativo de equipo. Actuar como referente técnico y organizativo, fomentando una cultura de servicio, seguridad y mejora continua. Impulsar la gestión del conocimiento y la documentación de procedimientos, reduciendo dependencias operativas no documentadas. 2) Operaciones IT y gestión del servicio (ITSM) Supervisar la operación diaria de la infraestructura corporativa: servidores físicos y virtuales, redes, almacenamiento, seguridad perimetral, telefonía, puestos de trabajo, copias de seguridad y servicios críticos. Definir, implantar y mejorar los procesos de gestión del servicio IT: incidencias, peticiones, cambios, problemas, inventario, activos, CMDB y catálogo de servicios. Asegurar la calidad y continuidad del servicio prestado por HelpDesk al cliente interno. Coordinar actuaciones planificadas fuera de horario cuando sean necesarias, minimizando el impacto sobre el negocio. Supervisar la monitorización de sistemas, redes y servicios para anticipar incidencias y degradaciones de servicio. Velar por la correcta ejecución de copias de seguridad, pruebas de recuperación, continuidad operativa y planes de contingencia. Establecer indicadores operativos (calidad de servicio, recurrencia de incidencias, cumplimiento de tareas) y proponer mejoras que reduzcan deuda operativa y riesgos tecnológicos. 3) Seguridad de la información y SGSI Gestión documental del SGSI: Mantener actualizadas las políticas, procedimientos y evidencias del SGSI, alineadas con ISO 27001, ENS, NIS2, RGPD u otros marcos aplicables. Participar en la identificación, análisis, valoración y plan de tratamiento de riesgos de seguridad de la información. Preparar evidencias, reportes e información técnica para auditorías internas, externas o revisiones de cumplimiento. Aplicación práctica de controles: Gestionar identidades, permisos y accesos aplicando el principio de mínimo privilegio y revisiones periódicas.
